title: Creamy Vegan Cilantro Lime Noodles
byline: Sam Turnbull @ It Doesn't Taste Like Chicken
ldIngredientsRaw: 1 cup raw cashews, (soaked or boiled if not using a high-speed blender, see notes)
2 packages Tofu Shirataki Spaghetti Shaped Noodles ((or sub thin rice noodles))
ldInstructionsRaw: This recipe is so quick and easy! Ready? Add the cashews, cilantro, water, garlic, lime zest, lime juice, salt, and pepper to a blender and combine until smooth and creamy.

Cook the Tofu Shiritaki noodles according to directions, drain then return to the pot. Add the cilantro lime sauce to the noodles, and toss to combine. Heat for another 1-2 minutes until the sauce has thickened and everything is heated through. Enjoy!
